name: Cheesy Skillet Gnocchi with Corn, Ricotta, and Basil

cookwares.name: large cast iron or stainless-steel skillet

ingredients.name: chopped fresh basil, plus more for garnish
extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for serving

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and preheat oven broiler on high. In a medium bowl, stir together mozzarella, ricotta, basil, lemon zest, crushed red pepper (if using), 2 tablespoons Parmesan, 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper; set aside.

In a large cast iron or stainless-steel skillet, heat oil over medium-high until shimmering. Add gnocchi and cook, without moving, until browned and crisp on bottom side, about 4 minutes. Stir, then continue cooking until browned in more spots, about 2 minutes. Add corn and cook, stirring occasionally, until corn is softened and beginning to char, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat, and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt and black pepper.
Using a soup spoon, dollop ricotta mixture evenly over gnocchi. Broil until cheese is melted and beginning to brown on top, 3 to 5 minutes.
Drizzle with more oil, and sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons Parmesan and additional basil. Serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: gnocchi recipe, Cheesy Skillet Gnocchi, 30 minute skillet dinner

description: This easy, 30-minute skillet dinner combines crisp gnocchi, sweet corn, creamy ricotta, and melty mozzarella for a fresh, satisfying meal.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (optional)

Optional substitutions: low-moisture mozzarella cheese → fontina cheese

Make-ahead and storage: Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Leah Colins
